page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.14xlarge is an instance in the Local SSDs family designed for storage-intensive and I/O-heavy computing environments. Powered by the KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 architecture, it integrates 56 dedicated vCPUs provided by Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. Backing this compute layer is 224.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No hardware GPU accelerators are included in this configuration.

A core characteristic of the instance is its local storage configuration, featuring 3126 GB of directly attached SSD capacity. This bundled local solid-state storage operates alongside a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile, providing high throughput for data transfer and disk-intensive operations without consuming network-attached storage bandwidth.

From an operational perspective, the instance provides cost efficiency through high resource density, combining substantial compute scale, 4 GB-per-core memory allocation, and large onboard solid-state storage within a single host allocation. Typical workloads suited for this configuration include relational databases, NoSQL engines, distributed data processing nodes, and large-scale data analytics tasks that require persistent, low-latency disk access and high core concurrency.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.14xlarge is a dedicated compute and storage instance within the Local SSDs family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with 56 dedicated vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture, powered by 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors, and paired with 224.0 GB of system memory at a ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance comes equipped with 3126 GB of bundled local SSD storage, eliminating the need for exclusive network storage dependencies for fast I/O workloads. A 10 Gbps baseline network interface handles external and inter-instance communication, while no discrete GPU hardware is present. With its dense core count, balanced memory footprint, and extensive attached solid-state capacity, the ecs.i1.14xlarge is designed for high-concurrency database deployments, NoSQL data stores, distributed data processing, and large-scale analytical workloads requiring rapid local disk access.
